content.name: SoulBot Agent Heartbeat v2.0.0
content.summary: Daily heartbeat: runs once at 00:00, executes recurring tasks, no chain.
content.description: Simplified heartbeat mode. Fires once per day via CronTrigger (00:00) when soulbot scheduler detects origin_channel='heartbeat'. Checks recurring_tasks array, executes any enabled tasks for today, then exits. No OnceTrigger chain — next execution is tomorrow's CronTrigger seed. Users can add recurring tasks via normal chat (AI modifies this file via file_system tool).

current_time.description: Current ISO timestamp from system context
current_time.agentic_prompt: Read the current time from the [CURRENT TIME] section in your system prompt.

heartbeat_guide.mechanism: Single daily CronTrigger at 00:00. No chain, no OnceTrigger follow-ups.
heartbeat_guide.skip_rule: If no recurring tasks match today, output [heartbeat:skip]. Always respond in User's Language.
heartbeat_guide.recurring_tasks_guide: Users can ask the AI to add recurring tasks during normal chat. The AI should use file_system tool to read this file, add the task to the recurring_tasks array, and write it back via atomic write (.tmp then rename). Changes take effect on the next daily heartbeat (mtime hot-reload in agent.py).

content.system_prompt: You are running in HEARTBEAT mode (Daily). Your job: (1) Read current time and day of week. (2) Check recurring_tasks for tasks enabled today. (3) Execute matched tasks. (4) If no tasks match, output [heartbeat:skip]. Do NOT create SOULBOT_CMD or schedule follow-ups. Always respond in User's Language.

aisop.main:
graph TD
    Start[Read Current Time] --> LoadTasks[Load Recurring Tasks]
    LoadTasks --> FilterDay{Filter by Day}
    FilterDay -- Has Tasks --> RunTasks[Execute Matched Tasks]
    FilterDay -- No Tasks --> SkipOutput[Output heartbeat:skip]
    RunTasks --> endNode((End))
    SkipOutput --> endNode

Start.step1: Read current time from [CURRENT TIME] in system prompt

LoadTasks.step1: Read the recurring_tasks array from the system content above
LoadTasks.step2: Filter tasks where enabled is true
LoadTasks.step3: Filter tasks that match today's day (by days field, if specified; if omitted, runs every day)

FilterDay.step1: If any tasks remain after filtering, route to RunTasks
FilterDay.step2: If no tasks remain, route to SkipOutput

RunTasks.step1: Execute each matched task following its action instructions
RunTasks.step3: Include results in output, clearly labeled by task name
RunTasks.constraints: Detailed, comprehensive, and humanized reply for each task.

recurring_tasks_schema.description: Schema for recurring tasks. Users can ask the AI to add tasks during normal chat.

example.name: Tokyo Weather Check
example.action: Search for current Tokyo weather and provide a detailed forecast

fields.name: Human-readable task name
fields.days: Optional array of days: mon/tue/wed/thu/fri/sat/sun. If omitted, runs every day.
fields.action: What the AI should do when this task fires
fields.tools: Optional list of tools needed for this task
fields.enabled: Set to false to temporarily disable without removing
